description: 外部待验证项关闭计划契约。该 gate 消费 audit handoff/current audit bundle 的 pending-external-validations.json，把每个 occurrence 映射为 owner、凭证依赖、关闭条件、复核命令和隐私边界；不连接真实外部系统，不把 pending live 写成 passed。

requiredInput.pendingExternalJson: current audit bundle 或 audit handoff 输出的 pending external validation occurrence array

categoryPolicy.manualTriageMeaning: 无法由规则自动识别的 occurrence 仍必须有 owner、关闭条件和人工复核命令；不得丢弃。
categoryPolicy.shipGate: 只要 pending item 数量大于 0，shipGate.status 必须为 blocked。

privacyBoundary: 输出只允许保存脱敏路径、行号、短 excerpt、hash、owner 类别、凭证类型和复核命令模板；不得保存真实 token、secret、DSN、私钥、生产日志正文、用户报告正文或外部账号数据。
nonClaims: Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not replace third-party audit review.
Does not authorize production credential use.
Does not close production API/HF/Bot/OIDC/SIEM/OTel/Vault/KMS/Postgres/webhook validations without separate real evidence.
